objective_text.T71.01.b: Implement pt_device_init/configure/close/recover with consumed matching tokens, unchanged success-output on failure, and externally certified quiescence before cleanup. Fail after each of the two control writes.

objective_text.T71.03.b: Implement pt_session_step for both roles, phase and remaining count, rejecting wrong direction/tag and terminal reuse without progress. Build an in-process two-endpoint trace driver using only synthetic messages.
objective_text.T71.03.c: Enumerate both roles, remaining0..8 and every phase/tag/direction, compare against a separately written transition table and assert rejected-state preservation. Reject direction-erasure and ACK-does-not-decrement mutants.
objective_text.T71.03.d: Introduce a choice between retryable rejection and cancellation, plus a peer crash between DATA and ACK. Specify which endpoint detects failure and whether a consumed message can be replayed; compare with the explicitly scoped guarantees of Sesh.

objective_text.T71.04.a: Derive least-common-ancestor exit/entry paths, inherited FAIL handling, external self transitions and internal PING; distinguish this bounded HSM subset from full UML semantics.
objective_text.T71.04.b: Implement pt_dispatch with inner-first exits, outer-first entries, a nonreentry guard, and transactional trace-capacity failure. Produce a table-driven independent transition oracle.
objective_text.T71.04.c: Check every active leaf/event pair, insufficient trace capacity, repeated BUSY START and PING exhaustion. Reject reversed-entry and omitted-exit mutants; compare exact action sequences rather than final states alone.
objective_text.T71.04.d: Add an entry action that posts another event and a guard on the parent transition. Queue the posted event until the current run-to-completion step ends and define guard fallback; the delayed variant introduces a local transition that intentionally preserves a composite state.

objective_text.T71.05.b: Compose the HSM with a four-slot copied-event ring; reject overflow unchanged and retain an event whose dispatch fails. Integrate learner-owned execution.tasks and sync.copied_queue through an explicit adapter.
